_about: One entry per county id of pipeline/counties.json: where the 'parcels' layer reads that county's parcels.
status 'approved': the owner says the county allows a stored copy (docs/DECISIONS.md D25). The build may run.
status 'blocked': the build stops with 'reason'. Nothing is requested.
outFields is the exact list sent to the service. pid, owner and acres name the fields that become the four tile properties (D27).
acres may be null when the county has no acreage field.
Never add a mailing address, site address, phone, tax or legal description field: lib/parcelsvc.py refuses such names.

il-macon.pidReason: The county's own parcel viewer (web map item 9bdfc0d29b1d4fc1b392b1f23c913dd1) shows ParcelNumb, labelled 'Parcel', in its pop-up and does not show PIN.

il-champaign.reason: No openly readable parcel service was found. Every parcel service of the Champaign County GIS Consortium needs a token, or is reached only through the consortium portal's proxy, which signs in with the consortium's stored login. D25 allows only a service that can be read without accepting the terms page and without a login. See docs/research/county-parcel-terms.md, 'Step 2 search for a readable service'.
